crossrefs.anchor: the imaginations of their hearts run wild
set their mouths against the heavens
their tongues strut across the earth
Does the Most High have knowledge
in vain I have kept my heart pure
in innocence I have washed my hands
I am afflicted all day long and punished every morning
When I tried to understand all this
How suddenly they are laid waste
Like one waking from a dream
You guide me with Your counsel
Whom have I in heaven but You
My flesh and my heart may fail
Those far from You will surely perish
it is good to draw near to God

evidence.text: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
